# AyushNetra v2.0

**AI-Enabled Integrated Early Warning, Treatment & Lifestyle Recommendation System for AHMIS**

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.10%2B-blue)](https://www.python.org/)
[![Docker](https://img.shields.io/badge/Docker-Ready-brightgreen)](https://www.docker.com/)
[![TRL](https://img.shields.io/badge/TRL-4%20→%209-orange)](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)

## 🎯 Overview

AyushNetra transforms the Ayush Hospital Management Information System (AHMIS) — deployed across 12,000+ centres — into an intelligent health ecosystem delivering:

- **VoiceEHR**: Secure, voice-based multilingual EHR creation in 22 Indian languages
- **OutbreakNet**: Real-time disease outbreak detection and 7-14 day regional forecasting
- **TreatmentRL**: Personalized AYUSH treatment, dietary, yoga & lifestyle recommendations
- **ExplainAI**: Explainable, confidence-scored outputs with continuous clinical learning

## 🏗️ Architecture

```
AyushNetra/
├── modules/              # 4 Core AI Modules
│   ├── voiceehr/        # Voice-based EHR creation
│   ├── outbreaknet/     # Disease outbreak detection
│   ├── treatmentrl/     # Treatment recommendation engine
│   └── explainai/       # Explainability & monitoring
├── infrastructure/       # Federated learning & deployment
├── services/            # API layer & integrations
├── edge/                # Edge deployment (ONNX)
└── data/                # Data pipelines & governance
```

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Prerequisites

- Python 3.10+
- Docker 26+
- Node.js 18+ (for frontend)
- GPU recommended (NVIDIA T4 or better) for training

### Installation

```bash
# Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/your-org/ayushnetra.git
cd ayushnetra

# Navigate to project root
cd /Users/dhairya/Desktop/AyushNetra-main

# Check if venv exists, create if not
if [ ! -d "venv" ]; then
    python3 -m venv venv
    echo "✔ Virtual environment created"
else
    echo "✔ Virtual environment exists"
fi

# Activate virtual environment
source venv/bin/activate

# Upgrade pip (minimal)
pip install --upgrade pip

# Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# Setup pre-commit hooks
pre-commit install

# Initialize data versioning
dvc init
```

### Run Locally

```bash
# Start all services
docker-compose up -d

# Access UI
open http://localhost:3000

# Access API docs
open http://localhost:8000/docs
```

## 📊 Modules

### Module 1: VoiceEHR
Voice-to-text → NER extraction → FHIR mapping → ABHA integration

**Tech Stack**: Whisper, SpaCy, IndicTrans2, HAPI FHIR

### Module 2: OutbreakNet
Anomaly detection (Isolation Forest + CUSUM) → Spatiotemporal GNN forecasting

**Tech Stack**: PyTorch Geometric, scikit-learn

### Module 3: TreatmentRL
Knowledge Graph constraints + Reinforcement Learning (PPO/BCQ)

**Tech Stack**: Neo4j, Stable-Baselines3, d3rlpy

### Module 4: ExplainAI
SHAP explanations + Confidence calibration + Drift monitoring

**Tech Stack**: SHAP, Evidently AI, MLflow

## 🔐 Security & Compliance

- ✅ DPDP Act 2023
